run_manus_mocap_evaluation: run the manus motion capture evaluation loop with a GeoRT model and hand kinematic viewer
load_model_by_ckpt_tag: load a GeoRT model by its checkpoint tag string for forward inference
create_manus_mocap_instance: create a ManusMocap instance to capture real-time hand motion data
build_hand_kinematic_model: build a HandKinematicModel from config with optional rendering enabled
get_hand_config: get the configuration for a specified hand type such as allegro
